panels.title: Wallet pool by role x status
panels.description: dvconf_wallet_pool_count{role,status} -- free/assigned/retired wallets per role, from cli.wallet.pool_status().

panels.title: On-chain registered miners by role
panels.description: dvconf_onchain_registered_count{role} -- MinerStore's per-role VecSet sizes (cp_miners/relay_miners/signaling_miners/validator_miners/user_miners), same read this session used to diagnose the quorum-inflation bug.

panels.title: Contract published
panels.description: dvconf_contract_published -- 1 if CONTRACT_PACKAGE_ID is set for the active env, else 0.

panels.title: Wallet pool detail
panels.description: dvconf_wallet_pool_count{role,status} as a table -- easier to scan exact counts than the pie chart above.

panels.title: Role-vote-cast rate vs. 2/3 quorum threshold
panels.description: dvconf_role_votes_cast_total and dvconf_role_assignments_total -- role_voting.move requires a 2/3 CP supermajority (base_threshold_bps = 6667). The dashed line is illustrative context, not a literal vote-count threshold (quorum is a FRACTION of active CPs, not a fixed count).

panels.title: Active rooms
panels.description: dvconf_rooms_active (signaling) -- same continuously-scraped metric as the Overview dashboard's "Active sessions / rooms" panel.

panels.title: Active workers (fleet-wide)
panels.description: count(up == 1) across every fleet worker job (relay/signaling/cp-daemon/validator-daemon/bot) -- excludes node_exporter/pushgateway, which aren't miner-role workers.

panels.title: Contract-state data freshness
panels.description: Seconds since the last `vidctl observer export-contract-state` push -- push_time_seconds is Pushgateway's own built-in per-job/instance metric, no extra instrumentation needed. Every OTHER panel on this dashboard is only as fresh as this value.

panels.title: Contract package & chain identity
panels.description: dvconf_contract_package_info{package_id,chain_id} -- already collected by export-contract-state, just never had a panel showing it before.

panels.title: Workers per role
panels.description: sum(up) by (job) across every fleet worker job -- how many relay/signaling/cp-daemon/validator-daemon/bot instances are currently reachable.

panels.title: Wallet pool (assigned) vs on-chain registered, by role
panels.description: dvconf_wallet_pool_count{status="assigned"} vs dvconf_onchain_registered_count -- a persistent gap between the two for the same role means onboarding is stuck (wallet checked out and assigned, but never made it on-chain).

panels.title: Registration / voting errors (fleet-wide)
panels.description: Every registering/voting role's stdout/stderr via Docker's loki logging driver (see deploy_one_service.yml's log_driver/log_options), filtered to error-looking lines and known on-chain registration/voting error codes (E_ALREADY_REGISTERED, E_NOT_RELAY, E_NOT_SIGNALING) -- shows WHY onboarding/voting is stuck, not just that a count isn't moving.
